title: Dynamic template ref name doesn't work since 3.2.25 version
body:
### Version
3.2.25

### Reproduction link
[sfc.vuejs.org/](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#)







### Steps to reproduce
1. Open link to [SFC Playground](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#).

2. Change version of vue to 2.2.25

3. Open console,  you will see that refs values have undefined value

```
input 1: undefined
input 2: undefined
```

4. Change version to 2.2.24, in console you will see that `input1` and `input2` values contain html element

```
input 1: <input ref_for=​"true">​
input 2: <input ref_for=​"true">​
```

### What is expected?
Dynamic template ref names should work as before.

### What is actually happening?
Dynamic template ref (with dynamic name) stopped work since 3.2.25 version
